description: Systems do not have documented security configuration baselines or are not configured according to established hardening standards. This signal indicates that system configurations may be inconsistent, ad-hoc, or not aligned with security best practices.
applicability: Applicable to all system types including servers, workstations, network devices, cloud resources, containers, and applications. Includes operating system configurations, application settings, and infrastructure-as-code templates.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through comparison of system configurations against documented baselines, CIS benchmarks, STIG requirements, or vendor hardening guides. May involve automated configuration scanning tools.
